description: List the tenant's warehouses (id, name, code, internal/external type, replenishment mode, and any custom field values set on the warehouse — customFields, keyed by fieldName; see list_custom_fields with entity=warehouse). Use the ids with set_inventory_levels / set_inventory_policy / transfer tools. Each warehouse also lists its stores (storeId, name, code): stores and warehouses are DISTINCT entities with different ids, and a warehouse's companion store shares its name, so when a store id is needed (import_historical_sales_orders, create_import_session, or the REST POST /api/v1/sales-orders/import endpoint) answer with stores[].storeId — the warehouse id is never a valid store id. Tenants get a Main warehouse at signup; create more with create_warehouse. Existing array shape is preserved. Omit limit for a complete list up to 100 warehouses; larger lists require explicit limit/offset. For explicit pages, advance offset by limit until a short page. Nested stores are capped at 1000 per response; use warehouseId with storeLimit/storeOffset to page one warehouse's stores in the same way. Set includeStores=false to discover warehouse ids without loading nested stores. Use includeCustomFields=false or customFieldNames to narrow large payloads.

customFieldNames.description: Optional exact custom field names to return, at most 100.

includeCustomFields.description: Include custom field values (default true); false avoids loading them.

includeStores.description: Include nested stores (default true). Set false for warehouse-id discovery.

limit.description: Explicit page size (1–100). Omit for a complete list up to 100 rows.

offset.description: Zero-based warehouse offset; requires limit when nonzero.

storeLimit.description: Explicit store page size (1–100); requires warehouseId.

warehouseId.description: Optional warehouse id to narrow the response or page its stores.

name: list_warehouses
title: List Warehouses
